gates.summary: Outcome Completion is an additive core extension composed through the existing Program and Runtime.
Deterministic assessment, host evidence admission, parent policy attenuation, incomplete-child propagation, CLI and negative fixtures pass.
Clean-room CommonJS and ESM consumers load Program, Runtime, Retrieval and Outcome exports; legacy CLI aliases remain.

The frozen public-safe v2 protocol completed 108 generation runs and 36 condition-blind AI review groups with zero provider failures and USD 0.7510377 recorded cost. Results support RC engineering review, not causal or production claims.
Independent Python checker commit 308c608b46a77a10366c2f22e78d7c5c39376031 passed against Mirai RC content commit bd1ee2649f6d083590ff61aea7818f76149d9acb on Linux, macOS and Windows.
An isolated AI-assisted review produced five reproducible findings; all were remediated and verified by TypeScript/Python tests and CodeQL. This is not an external human audit.
Exact RC content commit bd1ee2649f6d083590ff61aea7818f76149d9acb passed Linux, macOS, Windows and CodeQL.
Root package metadata and release documentation are frozen at 2.5.0-rc.1; tag, GitHub Release and npm publication remain separate live actions.
Engineering evidence is separated from external human validation, causal effectiveness and production-effect claims.

next_safe_action: The 2.5.0-rc.1 engineering candidate may be tagged and published only in a separately approved release batch. Production writes remain target-specific and require policy, capability, rollback and owner approval.
claim_boundary: Mirai 2.5.0-rc.1 is an engineering release candidate with controlled model evidence, independent implementation conformance and AI-assisted security review. It does not prove universal usefulness, authorize production effects, replace product-specific acceptance or constitute an external human security audit.
